result.topic_en: Mixed calculations: derivation of the equations of one-dimensional spherically symmetric gas motion (continuity and Euler equations), their transformation into characteristic (Riemann-invariant) form with characteristic coordinates, together with unrelated notes on a q-series recurrence, Möbius transformations of ratios of solutions of a second-order linear ODE, and an integral of an exponential function.
